    Bug 1970314 - openLinkIn: pass "_blank" instead of null as Services.ww.openWindow() name (to avoid console error). r=aleca
    
    Despite https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/61f64da2b20e50610d532675877ca4b5b9d6f1e4/toolkit/components/windowwatcher/nsIWindowWatcher.idl#48 does not seem null is liked.
    
    Clicking the link still "worked" as the event handler for the moz-support-link just fails and the link is normally opened...
    https://searchfox.org/mozilla-central/rev/61f64da2b20e50610d532675877ca4b5b9d6f1e4/toolkit/content/widgets/moz-support-link/moz-support-link.mjs#111
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253476

diff --git a/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js b/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
index f300b1106e2..1a2e4a84f44 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
+++ b/mail/base/content/utilityOverlay.js
@@ -360,7 +360,7 @@ function openLinkIn(url, where, openParams) {
   const win = Services.ww.openWindow(
     window,
     AppConstants.BROWSER_CHROME_URL,
-    null,
+    "_blank",
     "chrome,dialog=no,all",
     args
   );
title: Bug 1970314 - openLinkIn: pass "_blank" instead of null as Services.ww.openWindow() name (to avoid console error). r=aleca
